headline: Spectator Code of Conduct and a $24,500 contract for elementary basketball game personnel administration.
summary: The committee will consider approving a Spectator Code of Conduct for athletic events. It will also consider awarding the elementary school basketball game personnel contract to Manchester Youth Sports for $24,500.
items: Spectator Code of Conduct, presented by Dr. Kelly Espinola, Assistant Superintendent

Upcoming items: alumni athletes; roll and identification of community partners

SAU District Office,

 Large Conference Room  
 
9:00 a.m. –  Non-Meeting with Legal Counsel – exempt from public disclosure under the 
provisions of RSA 91-A:2, I (b) consultation with legal counsel. 
 
 
1. Chairwoman Stewart calls the meeting to order.  
 
2. The Clerk calls the roll.  
 
 
3. Public Forum 
 
4. Chairwoman Stewart advises the purpose of the public forum is to give the residents of 
Manchester the opportunity to address the board.  All people wishing to speak will have up to 
three (3) minutes to do so, and any comments must be directed to the chair.  Any resident 
wishing to speak will come forward to the nearest microphone, clearly state their name and 
address when recognized and give their comments. 
 
5. Chairwoman Stewart advises that if there is no one else present to speak and there are no other 
public comments that have been submitted, a motion would be in order to take all comments 
under advisement and to further receive and file any written documentation presented.  
 
 
6. Approval of the Minutes of the following meetings: September 9, 2026. 
 Ladies and Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
  
 
7. PRESENTATIONS
